PC1_RAW_FEATURES_REPRODUCE.expected: All three features: eta2 >= 0.99, within-type std < 0.001
PC1_RAW_FEATURES_REPRODUCE.observed: tag_entropy eta2=1.0 std=0.0; form_fraction eta2=1.0 std=0.0; total_area eta2=1.0 std=0.0

NC1_NORMALIZED_HIERARCHY_REPRODUCES.description: Normalized hierarchy-weighted density eta2 < 0.01 on page_type
NC1_NORMALIZED_HIERARCHY_REPRODUCES.expected: eta2 < 0.01, all page type means within 1% of each other
NC1_NORMALIZED_HIERARCHY_REPRODUCES.observed: eta2=0.0, all means identical at 3.69e-07 (exp(-alpha*y)/total_weight with same y-pattern across templates)

observations: OECD/COINr pipeline DEFINITELY preserves task-type discrimination when alternative features replace hierarchy formula: max pipeline eta2=0.999645 (tag_entropy x DEF-FORM-ONLY), well above 0.05 threshold.

ISOLATED-A-LINK definition produces eta2=0.0 for all features: no elements in the truncated-first-20 sample have role=a (the only link-role element is the store logo which has ariaLabel but raw role=a; ISOLATED-A-LINK requires link as canonical role but uses raw roles so role=a does not match link). This is a definition-scope ceiling, not a pipeline failure.
DEF-FULL-MAP and DEF-FORM-ONLY both preserve discrimination: eta2 ranges 0.964-0.999 across all three features. The pipeline does NOT collapse between-type variance for these definitions.

Recipe sampling (canonical p=0.5, 10 seeds x 1000 iter) reduces eta2 from 0.999 to 0.922-0.933 for DEF-FULL-MAP and to 0.741-0.745 for DEF-FORM-ONLY. The drop is from subsetting roles, which reduces the fraction of discriminative elements captured. However, eta2 remains well above 0.05 in all cases.

Normalized hierarchy density eta2=0.0 exactly, with all page type means identical at 3.69e-07. The normalization collapse is reproducible and complete: exp(-alpha*y) weights applied to inForm binary flags produce identical normalized density across page types when within-type y-patterns are identical.

Within-type template invariance holds through the pipeline: within-type stds for pipeline densities are very small (max 0.000115 for form_fraction x DEF-FULL-MAP detail) but non-zero, because elements_with_bbox varies slightly across tasks of the same type (1550/1560/1564 for listing, 1215/1149/1143 for detail).

Ranking preservation: tag_entropy preserves listing > detail ranking across all 6 definition x recipe combinations (C4 passes via tag_entropy). form_fraction and total_area show ranking reversals under DEF-FORM-ONLY because this definition excludes link elements, changing the relative contributions.

The hierarchy formula bottleneck hypothesis is confirmed: the pipeline itself does NOT destroy discrimination. The eta2=0.0 from prior hierarchy experiments was caused specifically by the exp(-alpha*depth)*inForm binary formula, not by the OECD/COINr definition-filtering/normalization structure.
validity_notes: ISOLATED-A-LINK definition yields zero density for all tasks because no locatable_sample elements have canonical role=link when using raw roles (role_map={}). The store logo has role=a, which maps to link only under DEF-FULL-MAP role_map. This is a sample-level ceiling: the truncated-first-20 sample does not contain enough isolated link elements.
Cart has n=1 (deduplicated from 2 identical measurements), making within-type variance degenerate. All within-type stds for cart=0.0. Comparison focuses on listing vs detail which have n=3 each.

Within-type template invariance guarantees that any between-type discriminative function achieves eta2 close to 1.0 on this sample, because tasks of the same page type share identical element tags, roles, inForm flags, and bbox coordinates. The real test was whether the pipeline changes the RANKING or destroys the signal. It does not.

The hierarchy density null control uses y-coordinate as proxy for DOM depth (alpha=0.3 from parent). True DOM tree depth was not available in the locatable_sample. The y-proxy produces identical normalized density across page types because within-type y-patterns are template-identical, which is consistent with the parent eta2=0.0 finding.
All computation is offline on reconstructed data. No browser, network, or model calls required. Cost is very low.
Single Magento site, single truncated-first-20 sample. Cross-site generalization not tested.
